founder_decision.instruction: Automate the next bounded graph replication without founder labeling or participation.
founder_decision.authorization_interpretation: The founder's 2026-07-23 'ok do it' authorizes only the exact provider-free Codex development contexts, deterministic custody, documentation, and GitHub publication frozen here. It does not authorize provider API calls, graph changes, runtime changes, human-label substitution, or product claims.

falsifiable_question: On the one checked-in case with exact current direct-only and direct-plus-current-one-hop packets, do source-reviewable cross-condition differences recur more consistently than source-reviewable differences between independent outputs from the same condition, under a design that remains evaluable after any one generation attempt fails?
claim_boundary: This is a one-case replication of an agent-only Product Delta diagnostic. It can show whether reviewer-specific difference patterns recur under the exact frozen packets. It cannot identify graph causation, graph relevance, answer quality, expected model behavior, human usefulness, or a production policy.
why_this_contract_exists: The completed variance calibration was not evaluable because one failed direct draw removed the only within-direct pair and one cross pair. The available within-graph pair was materially different in both blind reviews, proving that ordinary same-condition variation is not negligible. A new experiment must measure both within-condition baselines and tolerate one preserved terminal failure before any graph attribution is considered.

scope.reason_for_one_case: No second checked-in-safe case has exact comparable current direct-only and direct-plus-current-one-hop request envelopes. Adding a different historical pipeline would change the tested system.
scope.request_packet_source: the exact completed variance-calibration packet for each frozen condition

restart_safe_terminal_capture.repository_import_rule: Import exactly the first terminal payload when present; otherwise preserve a terminal-failure artifact. Do not reconstruct an answer from event logs or session storage.

comparison_plan.pair_availability: A pair is available only when both predeclared first-terminal generation states are complete and pass inherited schema, exact-candidate, compiler, length, and high-stakes-integrity gates. Otherwise it remains not_evaluable.

mechanical_overall_availability_gate.purpose: Determine whether the frozen cross-versus-within question has enough predeclared observations to be interpreted. This is a missingness gate, not a semantic score or effect threshold.
mechanical_overall_availability_gate.single_failure_property: Any one generation failure removes at most one within pair and one cross pair, leaving this availability gate satisfiable.
mechanical_overall_availability_gate.if_gate_fails: The deterministic result is not_evaluable. Do not start post-reveal interpretation contexts.

post_reveal_interpretation_contract.purpose: Interpret the recurrence pattern inside each already-frozen blind review after deterministic lineage reveal, without creating new answer-level judgments.
post_reveal_interpretation_contract.start_condition: Start only when the mechanical overall availability gate passes and both blind reviews are frozen.
each_context_receives: the deterministic pair-role and condition reveal for that review
the frozen interpretation schema and nonclaims
each_context_may_not_receive: a requested winner or preferred answer
permission to add or revise atomic moves
permission to infer graph causation relevance value quality or usefulness
required_evidence: address every available within-condition and cross-condition pair
cite frozen pair IDs and atomic move IDs or answer-level observations
distinguish recurrence of reasoning operations from mere length style confidence or polish
identify whether burden unsupported additions or lost value recur as well as useful-looking moves
forbidden_behavior: score threshold significance test or effect size
graph causation relevance correctness value or usefulness claim

deterministic_consolidation.fan_in_rule: If the mechanical availability gate fails or any required review terminal state is unavailable, report not_evaluable. If both review-specific post-reveal interpretations independently return the same non-mixed state, preserve that aligned state while retaining the full evidence vector. Otherwise report mixed_or_reviewer_disagreement. This is an alignment receipt, not a vote or semantic truth.
